goal: Implement approved A1 publish integrity, then A2 answer provenance and A3 feedback from mobile through backend to Admin, with synthetic local validation and no cloud deployment.
successCriteria: A1 real Edge normalization matches RPC SQL, rejects stale publication and safely replays identical request IDs; null fallback remains disabled.
A2 preserve optional backward-compatible provenance and exact answer through save/reopen/retry; invalid outputs cannot claim successful AI.
A3 online receipt/offline queue/failure states are honest and scoped to account; Admin triages feedback linked to versions without raw user content.
Only local source and isolated synthetic tests change; cloud activation, credentials, production and ledger remain untouched.
untouchedSurfaces: All existing dirty changes are preserved; no reset or old migration rewrite.
Cloud database, existing local databases, production, credentials, real user data and provider calls remain untouched.
Tarot/astrology content/artwork and deterministic chart/card logic unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Admin Model Router publication first; later Tarot/Astrology results and Journal report/save actions plus protected Admin feedback inbox.
impact.dataWrite: A1 local code and new forward migration only; test uses task-only isolated synthetic database. Later account-scoped local answer snapshots/feedback queue and proposed remote feedback tables via reviewed forward SQL.
impact.backendContract: A1 canonical nested route payload, expected active ID and idempotent request receipt. Later additive answer provenance and feedback schema with authenticated ownership validation.
impact.adminVisibility: Loaded/draft/published/runtime-observed separate; no invented metrics. Later sanitized feedback inbox with explicit provenance trust and audit.
impact.privacySafety: Synthetic fixtures only; no raw private logs, birth records, secrets or user excerpts. Default feedback is bounded metadata; optional raw excerpt remains disabled unless fully controlled.
impact.observability: Explicit version metadata allowlist and trace trust boundaries; client observation cannot masquerade as authoritative provider execution.
impact.rollback: Restore scoped task diff without resetting prior work. Forward database changes additive; older snapshots remain readable. Cloud rollback and migration application are separate reviewed actions.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: No content expansion, artwork, model provider activation, calculator changes, billing policy changes, cloud retarget or deployment.
impact.agentHandoff: Root completes remaining work. Prior agent output retained and reviewed; no active delegation.

canonicalContracts: A1 admin-model-router-config/contract.ts defines accepted route publish envelope, mapped identically to forward SQL RPC.
A2 shared answer provenance module/schema will be versioned and consumed by mobile/backend without raw content.
A3 feedback contract will whitelist enum/id provenance, enforce ownership/RBAC and separate submitted metadata from verified server source.

securityReview.authzRls: Preserve backend admin capability checks and RPC authorization; add expected revision and scoped idempotency. Tests use ordinary synthetic roles, never live service-role bypass as acceptance.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No real data. Feedback initially metadata only; raw excerpt input absent. New snapshots are existing user-local answer data under current account boundary.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Never read env/key files or echo secrets. Local tests have fictional identities and no cloud endpoints.
securityReview.externalInput: Validate all enum/id/size/ownership and stale versions. Provider output and client metadata untrusted; retain validation stages and producer labels.
securityReview.dependencies: Existing locked runtimes; no dependency upgrades. Reuse existing isolated native PostgreSQL adapter or installed PGlite only if available; no downloaded unreviewed tools.
securityReview.migrationRelease: New CLI-created forward migrations only. No cloud db push/repair/apply. Optional local synthetic database uses network-none task-only fixture, no existing database. Ledger/target approval unchanged.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop for unresolved high-risk preflight findings, real user data, cloud/deployment/credential actions. Server receipt verifies only its service-written metadata; legacy trace content remains unverified. Metadata-only feedback excludes excerpts and notes.
